# Webcam Test (webcamtestlive.com)

> Free online webcam, microphone and speaker test that runs entirely in the browser. It shows the live camera picture and measures resolution, frame rate, bitrate, aspect ratio and image quality, with no download, no account and nothing uploaded.

Webcam Test is a static site built on standard browser APIs (getUserMedia and the Web Audio API). Camera and microphone streams are processed on the visitor's own device; there is no server that receives media. Every measurement is taken live from real frames rather than read from a spec sheet.

## Tools

- [Webcam test](https://webcamtestlive.com/): Start the camera, see the live preview, and get resolution, frame rate, bitrate and lighting readings with automatic health checks and a copyable diagnostics report.
- [Online video recorder](https://webcamtestlive.com/video-recorder): High-definition in-browser webcam video and microphone audio recorder with pause/resume, zero watermarks, and 1-click WebM/MP4 downloads.
- [Webcam recorder](https://webcamtestlive.com/webcam-recorder): Free online camera recorder for quick video capture without software downloads.
- [Webcam resolution test](https://webcamtestlive.com/resolution): Shows the current stream resolution and the maximum the camera supports (360p, 480p, 720p, 1080p, 4K), and explains why the live figure is often lower.
- [Webcam FPS test](https://webcamtestlive.com/fps): Counts the frames the browser actually presents to report a delivered frame rate, with the five usual causes of a low result.
- [Microphone test & echo playback](https://webcamtestlive.com/mic-test): Live input level meter for the microphone with a 5-second voice recording and playback loop (echo test) to hear how your voice sounds to others.
- [Keyboard test](https://webcamtestlive.com/keyboard-test): Interactive virtual keyboard tester to diagnose dead keys, test keyboard ghosting, and evaluate N-key rollover (NKRO).
- [Screen test](https://webcamtestlive.com/screen-test): Fullscreen solid color monitor diagnostic (Black, White, Red, Green, Blue) to detect dead, stuck, and hot pixels with a built-in rapid RGB stuck pixel fixer.
- [Dead pixel test](https://webcamtestlive.com/dead-pixel-test): Fast monitor inspection tool for checking dead pixels on laptops and desktop displays.
- [Speaker test](https://webcamtestlive.com/speaker-test): Calibrated stereo left and right channel audio test with 120Hz, 440Hz, and 2000Hz frequency tones for headphones and speakers.
- [Webcam mirror](https://webcamtestlive.com/mirror): Full-screen webcam mirror with horizontal flip toggle to check appearance, lighting, and hair before meetings.
- [Take photo with webcam](https://webcamtestlive.com/take-photo): One-click HD camera snapshot tool to capture and download clear PNG pictures directly without uploads.
- [Embeddable webcam widget generator](https://webcamtestlive.com/widget): Interactive embed customizer allowing webmasters, online interview platforms, and schools to generate responsive camera and mic testing widgets with zero maintenance.
- [Embeddable webcam widget](https://webcamtestlive.com/embed): Clean iframe widget allowing webmasters, online interview platforms, and schools to embed camera and mic testing directly on their websites.

## Device & Platform Diagnostics

- [Webcam test for Mac](https://webcamtestlive.com/mac): Test FaceTime HD cameras on MacBook Air, MacBook Pro, iMac, and Continuity Camera with macOS System Settings permission guidance.
- [Webcam test for Windows 11 & 10](https://webcamtestlive.com/windows): Diagnose Windows 11 and 10 camera permissions, physical privacy shutters, and Device Manager driver issues.
- [Webcam test for Chromebook](https://webcamtestlive.com/chromebook): Test ChromeOS internal and USB cameras with site permission and school admin policy troubleshooting.
- [Zoom camera test](https://webcamtestlive.com/zoom): Pre-meeting checklist, video framing grid, and microphone level validation before joining Zoom calls.
- [Google Meet camera test](https://webcamtestlive.com/google-meet): Chrome WebRTC video check, lighting calibration, and microphone testing before Google Meet calls.
- [Microsoft Teams camera test](https://webcamtestlive.com/teams): Video framing, background blur FPS check, and audio device validation for Microsoft Teams.

## Guides

- [Webcam not working? How to fix it](https://webcamtestlive.com/troubleshooting): A 60-second checklist, the camera-permission path for Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari, Android and iOS, Windows and macOS system settings, and what NotAllowedError, NotFoundError, NotReadableError and OverconstrainedError mean.
- [Webcam test FAQ](https://webcamtestlive.com/faq): How to test a webcam on Windows 10, Windows 11, Mac, laptop or PC, and what the results mean.

## Languages

The webcam test is also available in Vietnamese (https://webcamtestlive.com/vi), Brazilian Portuguese (https://webcamtestlive.com/pt-br), Russian (https://webcamtestlive.com/ru), Indonesian (https://webcamtestlive.com/id) and Hindi (https://webcamtestlive.com/hi). The guides are in English.

## Key facts

- Video calls look sharp at 1280×720 (720p) and excellent at 1920×1080 (1080p); anything below 640×480 looks soft on a large screen.
- 30 frames per second is the target for video calls; 24 fps is acceptable; below 15 fps looks choppy. Low light is the most common cause of a low frame rate.
- Browsers only allow camera access on HTTPS pages and always ask for permission first.
- Nearly every "camera not working" report comes down to one of four causes: a blocked permission, another app holding the camera, the wrong device selected, or a closed privacy shutter.
